title: Compose a drum-first creative Big Beat score
description: Use the strengthened Big Beat workflow to create a drum-first, creatively distinct Big Beat score: audition a tom-led or otherwise new drum identity before adding a non-vocal sample hook, then render and measure it.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Built Fence Signal using the new drum-first gate. Auditioned an eight-bar tom-led drum sketch before adding Percussive Fences. Full score has six distinct phrase-level drum roles and 21 stems; full render measured objective_v2 101.49. Final audition audio is renders/fence-signal-audition/big-beat-fence-signal-bars-1-16.m4a.
